ancillary_coverage.corporate_actions: One all-types SPY request, process_date filtered from anchor-31d to last+31d (default data_quality=complete). Actions are placed by their documented ex_date or effective_date, never by process_date. Cash dividends and capital-gains distributions (sum of the long/short-term legs provided) are reinvested by the benchmark and flattened by the ex-distribution diagnostic; same-date payouts of the two types add. A same-ticker name change (old and new symbol both SPY) changes no valuation and is counted as non-gating metadata. Other non-cash SPY actions that cannot be placed, or that take effect in the window, are UNRESOLVED as unsupported valuations.
ancillary_coverage.dividend_quarter_presence: Every window quarter must show a cash-dividend ex-date (SPY pays quarterly per its issuer). This is a conservative coverage sanity check only.
limitations: Alpaca documents no guarantee on corporate-action creation or processing delay, so the 31-day process_date margin is not a completeness bound.
Quarter presence cannot prove that every historical action was returned; an absent split in the response is not certified absence.
Vendor adjustment changes have no machine-readable feed. The review record is a bounded human documentation review; it does not prove that no undocumented change exists.

A cash payout with a missing or empty currency is assumed to be USD (the vendor documents empty as USD, n/a or unknown); SPY is a USD fund and the payout feeds only the non-gating benchmark diagnostic. Such records are counted; any other currency is UNRESOLVED, never converted.
ancillary_coverage.vendor_adjustment_review: Collection, PASS and scoring require the hash-bound local review record at VENDOR_REVIEW_PATH (status reviewed, SPY, window and protocol hash bound, no known unresolved changes); its SHA256 is in the manifest and the validation identities.
